claim: Sanofi reported that the phase 3 PERSEUS trial of tolebrutinib in primary progressive multiple sclerosis did not meet its primary endpoint of delaying 6-month composite confirmed disability progression.
future_grounding_route: Reassess only after a full peer-reviewed report or participant-level data become available; meanwhile treat PPMS extrapolation from HERCULES as unsupported.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: Context dependence is a recurring project failure constraint

project_use: External warning against extrapolating a treatment effect across progressive-MS phenotypes and against treating pathway-level plausibility as phenotype-invariant.
relationship_note: The sponsor-reported negative PPMS result is consistent with the project's context-dependence prefilter. It is not a project-grounded demonstration of why the trial failed.

source.citation: Sanofi. Tolebrutinib did not meet the primary endpoint in the phase 3 PERSEUS study in primary progressive multiple sclerosis. Press release, 15 December 2025.
source.label: Sanofi PERSEUS topline report

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: Sponsor press-release metadata and short paraphrase
source_terms.reuse_notes: This is a sponsor-reported topline result; no full peer-reviewed analysis was identified at access time, so interpretation must remain limited.

why_unverifiable: Only sponsor-reported topline information was available to the project; participant-level data and a complete peer-reviewed analysis were unavailable.
